_comment: Canonical risk limits for the Growth book — the single source of truth for the deterministic reference-weight math (collector `_build_reference_weights`), the prompt's hard guardrails, and the trade-validation layer. Mirrors growth_strategy_spec_v1.md §3/§8. Keep spec, prompt, and this file in agreement. All percentages are of EQUITY unless the key says `_of_core`.
_active_quadrant_ceiling_note: Confirmed by account holder 2026-06-30: 90% of CORE (not the spec's 80% default). The living-hedge rule — the active quadrant takes at most this share of the core block; the remaining ~10% stays spread across the other quadrants at/near the sleeve floor so a wrong call always leaves a residual hedge (spec §0.2, §3, §8). Flex and cash are SEPARATE sleeves outside the core block (see ceiling base decision).
_sleeve_floor_note: 0.1% / >=1-share floor on every core sleeve — the primary risk control (spec §0.2). Never zero. The 1-share minimum is the binding floor for higher-priced names (Phase 1 is integer-shares-only).
_single_name_cap_note: Flex single-name cap 3-4% (spec §8); ~15% soft cap on any one name. Core ETF sleeves are governed by the quadrant targets + ceiling, not a single-name cap.
_cash_sleeve_note: Cash sleeve = literal cash + SGOV, held to 5-15% of equity; shock_level 3 may lift the ceiling toward 25% temporarily (spec §7, prompt Cash sleeve). This is a SEPARATE sleeve outside the core block. Because the sleeve = SGOV + literal cash, a literal-cash -> SGOV conversion does NOT change the sleeve total (a pure composition swap): the Tier-1 validator (shared/trade_validation.py) therefore EXEMPTS a SGOV buy from SGOV's per-name window when it is funded purely from pre-trade literal cash (not same-day sell proceeds) down to the literal_cash_target_pct buffer, clamping to that budget rather than rejecting. This fixes the 2026-07-09 idle-cash pathology (SGOV 28.44% vs 28.50% window ceiling rejected a $4k cash->SGOV swap, stranding ~5% of equity in cash).
_flex_sleeve_note: Flex aggregate <= ~15% until it clears its hurdle in paper, hard cap <= 25% (spec §7). Enforced by the flex engine; a SEPARATE sleeve outside the core block.
_exempt_holds_note: RETIRED (roster_revision_2026-07). The permanent AMZN/GOOGL exempt hold is gone — both are LEGACY_EXITS now (liquidated in tranches, never re-bought into core; QQQ retains the mega-cap exposure at index weight). Kept as an empty list so the validator V2 rule and the reference-weight pinning become NO-OPS rather than being deleted — the machinery survives for any future designated hold.
_conviction_ladder_note: Risk Score -> active-quadrant target as a share of CORE (the midpoint/representative of each prompt band, made into a number so the LLM executes toward it rather than interpreting a prose range). Top rung is capped at the 90% ceiling. Monotonic: lower risk score (higher conviction) concentrates harder. At 9-10 (no read) the book is capital-preservation: minimal quadrant bet, lean to ballast.

thematic_conviction._note: D-4/D-5 (2026-08-14). The book had no path from a live named theme to a position size: project-instructions.md told the analyst to 'note the linkage in the rebalancing rationale' and nothing more, so a sustained Hormuz oil disruption left VDE pinned at a 1-share 0.097% floor for four consecutive sessions. Jorge's decision (2026-08-14) is that the LLM advises via an explicit probability-of-increase rather than a mechanical price-level trigger, and that the resulting size scales by confidence rather than being fixed. p_up_min bands are deliberately coarse -- a continuous probability-to-weight map is false precision and jitters session-to-session. brier_damping closes the Phase-C loop: a model that cannot beat the base rate loses the lever mechanically rather than by human intervention. PENDING JORGE'S SANITY CHECK (FOLLOWUPS): the p_up_min band edges and target_pct_of_equity values above are a starting proposal, not yet reviewed.

conviction._note: 2026-08-14 flex-conviction-path cycle. The flex sleeve filed zero nominations for 4 of 5 sessions (08-10/08-12/08-13/08-14) because the catalyst path REQUIRES a dated catalyst -- and a real, live European-defense-capex theme (EUAD +16-22pp 60d excess vs SPY for four straight sessions) had none, so the model correctly declined it every day under the only entry path that existed. This is a SECOND, parallel nomination path: the LLM advises via p_up (probability the ticker's total return is positive over horizon_days, 15-30d) rather than requiring a dated event. THE SINGLE MOST IMPORTANT DESIGN POINT: edge = p_up - base_rate_up, NOT p_up alone. A 15-30d broad equity ETF rises ~55-58% of the time unconditionally -- an absolute p_up>=0.52 threshold is BELOW the base rate and would fire on nearly every candidate, indistinguishable from having no signal at all. base_rate_up is the empirical fraction of overlapping horizon_days-length windows with positive total return over the trailing base_rate_lookback_days (~2y) -- computed per candidate, never assumed at 0.50. Unavailable or fewer than base_rate_min_windows overlapping windows -> the candidate is NOT conviction-eligible this session (fail-closed, never a substituted 0.50). size_mult scales the size the EXISTING risk-budget/per-name-cap/sleeve-cap sizing chain produces -- it is not an independent percent of equity, and none of those existing caps are relaxed. catalyst_size_mult (1.5) and catalyst_promotes_band (both on by default -- Jorge should sanity-check, see decision gate G-2, this is roughly a 2x effective amplification together) apply ONLY when a conviction nomination also carries a real dated catalyst within horizon_days -- both applied BEFORE the per-name/sleeve caps, never after, so the amplifier can never breach a cap. confirm_sessions/release_sessions/max_session_delta_pct_of_equity mirror PR #38's thematic-conviction hysteresis discipline exactly (same doctrine, separate state -- flex entries track price/stop/horizon in a way core reference weights don't). Ladder edge_min/size_mult values, like PR #38's thematic ladder, are a STARTING PROPOSAL pending Jorge's sanity check -- see FOLLOWUPS #63 (re-scoped to cover both ladders).

_no_read_ballast_note: In a low-conviction / no-read regime (conviction proxy >= conviction_score_min, i.e. the 'low' and 'no_read' ladder rungs), the spec §Calculated-Risk-Score says: overweight GLD + long-duration Treasuries (TLT), push the cash sleeve toward its ceiling, minimal quadrant bet. So the reference routes ballast_target_pct_of_core to the ballast_names (split equally) instead of leaving the tiny active-quadrant target to be swamped by the AMZN/GOOGL exemption on renormalize. This fixes the degenerate no-read reference (was GOOGL 38% / AMZN 22%). Cash is separately pushed toward its ceiling by conviction elsewhere.
_borderline_blend_note: When an axis is flat/indeterminate or active_quadrant is unknown (or a transition_watch is active), concentrate into the INTERSECTION of the candidate quadrants (assets that work in both) at the intersection target, and hold the DIVERGENT bets at staged/partial size. Borderline must produce a specific posture, never a freeze (spec §3 living-hedge + brief Phase 1).
_override_protocol_note: Phase 4 (Tier-2). The analyzer executes toward reference_weights and may deviate only via a structured, falsifiable override record. max_magnitude_pp = the hard Tier-2 band — and per Finding 2 D1 it caps the RESIDUAL an override may SHELTER, not the move: for an out-of-band sleeve, required_move_total = max(0, gap - max(allowed_residual, gap_band_pp)) MUST still trade (see reference_execution). Overrides are PER-SLEEVE (mandatory 'sleeve' field, OVERRIDE_SCHEMA_V1_1). gap_band_pp = how far a sleeve's Current may sit off Reference before the analyzer MUST either trade toward it or file an override — a 'hold' beyond this band is itself an override toward inaction and must carry a record. ASYMMETRY (spec §6): a de-risk override (toward more defense) passes with >=1 clean evidence item at full size; a re-risk override (toward more risk / less defense) needs >= re_risk_min_evidence items, else it is DOWNSIZED (magnitude halved), and with no evidence it is rejected. Structural gates (falsifier + falsifier_date + clean_data_only + within band + valid direction + sleeve) apply to both. An override never loosens the deployment gate. relative_band_frac (2026-08-06 audit O4) — the HYBRID band: a sleeve's effective shelter is min(gap_band_pp, relative_band_frac * reference_pct) whenever reference_pct > 0, so a small strategic target (e.g. intl_broad/VXUS at a 2.0% reference) becomes enforceable once it drifts more than relative_band_frac of its OWN reference away, rather than sheltering forever inside the fixed 5pp band built for the much-larger core amplifiers. A zero-reference sleeve (LEGACY_EXITS, a zeroed non-selected pool member) is unaffected — the relative term never applies when reference_pct <= 0, so its shelter stays the plain absolute gap_band_pp.
_reference_execution_note: Finding 2 (D2/D3) — kills the silent-hold gap. D2 tranche rule: per out-of-band sleeve per session, required_move_today = min(required_move_total, tranche_pp_max); a trade moving >= required_move_today toward reference is CONFIRMING (progress at tranche pace is first-class, the residual needs NO override). D3 enforcement: when the model's trades fall short of required_move_today AND the corrective move is DE-RISK (selling an overweight Amplifier name / buying an underweight Damper or SGOV name per shared/quadrants.py), the analyzer synthesizes the shortfall as a source='band_enforcement' trade; re-risk shortfalls are NEVER synthesized, only flagged (spec §6 asymmetry — quick to reduce risk deterministically, deliberate to add it). Synthesized trades respect integer shares, min_notional_usd, sells-before-buys, cash-after-sells, the deployment gate, EXEMPT_HOLDS, and the per-session enforcement_turnover_max_pct of equity. enforce=false disables synthesis (shortfalls are then only flagged).

transition_watch._note: Task C (2026-08-14 audit). transition_watch was stateless: a single session's activation blew the Q2 reference block from 0.091% to 4.118% and back to 0.091% the very next day (the 2026-08-12 VDE whipsaw, itself downstream of the B1 stale-oil-leg bug), proposing ~$10k of Q2 damper buys one day after selling those same dampers. confirm_sessions/release_sessions add the SAME N=2 confirmation discipline the axis-direction confirmation (AxisDirectionState) already uses elsewhere in this system, applied here to the (projected_quadrant, direction) pair rather than a single label. max_session_delta_frac caps the per-session CHANGE in the applied staged fraction (not just the activation gate) so even a fully-confirmed transition ramps in/out over multiple sessions instead of stepping the full 0.30/0.15 in one shot. 2026-08-21 quadrant-reachability audit (Task A) adds staged_fraction_re_risk_joint: when BOTH the growth and inflation leading sides are activatable and BOTH resolve re_risk, transition_watch composes the DIAGONAL quadrant (e.g. Q4->Q2) instead of picking one side's single-axis projection -- the diagonal was otherwise structurally unreachable (F1 root cause). Set below staged_fraction_re_risk (0.15) because a two-axis posture change is bigger than a one-axis one -- start conservative (decision D-7). re_risk_min_confirmations now also gates against a THIRD source (market_implied_quadrant.structural_inflation_score, Task B) -- see divergence-config.json's leading_vs_lagging_inflation note. Kept at 2 pending decision D-3 (whether 1-of-3 should stage; currently inert against the 08-21 readings at 1-of-3).

_policy_axis_note: FOLLOWUPS #16 — the resolved policy leg of the classifier (collector _build_policy_axis). LAYERING: the manually-maintained fomc-stance.json is the OVERRIDE layer — while its as_of is within manual_fresh_days it GOVERNS (a real SEP/dot-plot beats a market proxy); when it is stale or null, the MARKET-IMPLIED stance governs: DGS2 20-session delta >= +dgs2_delta_20d_bp_hawkish bp -> hawkish repricing, <= -dgs2_delta_20d_bp_dovish bp -> dovish, else neutral (DGS2-DFF spread emitted as context). 'unconfirmed' only when BOTH layers are unavailable. Gate semantics unchanged: fail-closed on hawkish; unconfirmed cannot confirm Q1.
_transition_watch_note: Realized inflation is laggy, so the Q3->Q4 (etc.) turn is called late. When the Phase-2 `leading_vs_lagging_inflation` divergence is active, transition_watch pre-stages a PARTIAL, BOUNDED lean in reference_weights toward the projected quadrant WITHOUT flipping the binding active_quadrant / regime_gate / realized inflation axis (spec §6). Convex blend fraction f: reference = (1-f)*base + f*projected. ASYMMETRY (§6 safety): a de-risk transition (projecting a MORE defensive quadrant) stages readily at staged_fraction_de_risk; a re-risk transition (projecting a MORE offensive quadrant) needs a higher bar — at least re_risk_min_confirmations leading signals confirming (breakeven AND oil, not just one) — and a smaller staged_fraction_re_risk; below the bar it does not activate. Reuses the Phase-2 divergence — never re-derives the leading/realized tension.
_bond_signals_note: 2026-08-06 audit B1 — `credit.hy_oas.trend_4w` (tightening/widening/flat) was referenced by both `_build_leading_growth` and `_build_market_implied_quadrant` but never actually SET by `_build_bond_signals` (a key-name mismatch — the dict only ever carried `delta_20d_bp` etc.), so the HY-OAS vote silently read None in both consumers every session. `trend_4w` is now derived from `delta_20d_bp` vs +/-hy_oas_trend_bp (tightening below -bp, widening above +bp, else flat).
_labor_leading_note: 2026-08-06 audit O3 — ADP private payrolls (FRED NPPTTL) as a deterministic LEADING labor sub-signal, surfaced explicitly (collector._build_labor_leading) as a forward-risk flag; it never overwrites the binding BLS-PAYEMS scorecard in labor_signals. forward_softening_gap_k is how far below the trailing 3m-average pace (in thousands) the latest ADP print must miss to flag forward_softening_flag. Motivating incident: 08-05's ADP miss (+44K vs +70K consensus) — the session's most important forward labor signal — was caught only because the analyzer happened to parse it out of the forex-news feed.
_growth_axis_rollover_note: FOLLOWUPS #54: head-to-tail slope alone misreads a trajectory that already peaked/troughed mid-window as still moving in its original direction (2026-08-03/04/05 live evidence). `band` is the existing rising/falling/flat threshold on GDPNow points; `drawdown_threshold` gates rollover detection (peak-to-tail fall, or trough-to-tail rise) and defaults to the same value as `band` (decision H-1, 2026-08-21) since a rollover smaller than the band that already governs direction classification isn't a meaningfully different move.
_inflation_quality_note: FOLLOWUPS #19: diagnostics-only inflation-quality context (Atlanta Fed sticky/flexible-price CPI, Dallas Fed trimmed-mean PCE, UMich 1y expectations) surfaced alongside the realized-core inflation axis. `band` gates each series' own month-over-month rising/falling/flat read. NOT wired into transition_watch confirmation — decision D-3/#78 on the inflation-side re-risk bar remains open and stays 2-of-3; a 4th source here would silently change that arithmetic.
_market_shock_note: 2026-08-06 audit B3 — the news channel used to trigger off ABSOLUTE daily keyword-hit counts (>=20/15/5) with no baseline, so a persistent multi-week theme (e.g. Iran/Hormuz, 130-147 hits/day) permanently maxed shock_level at 3 with the price channel benign (SPY up, VIX down) — the news channel alone drove the 25%-of-equity shock3_ceiling every session. The news channel now scores a Z-SCORE of total_hits vs a trailing news_baseline_window_sessions-session mean/std (persisted to blob market-shock/news-hits-history.json; news_baseline_min_sessions of history required before a z-score computes at all — until then a conservative single-session no_baseline_watch_floor_hits floor caps news-alone at 'watch'). PRICE and NEWS channels are scored independently (price: SPY/VIX/DXY hard signals + credit-stress escalation, unaffected by news) and combined via level=max(price_level, news_level). The SYMMETRIC benign-tape guard: whenever price_level<=1 ('benign' — no elevated/acute price signal), news-alone is capped at level 2, or level 1 once the SAME dominant news category has held >= persistent_theme_hits_floor hits for >= persistent_theme_sessions consecutive sessions (the Iran/Hormuz case) — level 3 requires genuine price-channel corroboration. dxy_news_corroboration_hits is the pre-existing DXY-move-plus-news-corroboration combo (kept — DXY is a price signal, so this was never the bug).
_literal_cash_floor_note: Task D (F6, 2026-07-23): after any SGOV sweep, the analyzer's post-model guard trims the sweep notional so that literal cash does not fall below this fraction of equity. Prevents the 07-22 ratchet (sweep sized without netting same-day buy notionals, leaving cash at 0.79% vs the 1.50% target). D-G1 default 0.75%.
_price_quarantine_note: Task E (F7, 2026-07-23): flex-candidate prices are quarantined when outside the symbol's 52-week high/low range by > range_pct OR moved > single_day_move_pct vs the prior snapshot EOD without a corroborating news hit. Quarantined names carry price_quarantined: true + reason and are treated as failing G2 (data sufficiency) by the flex gatekeeper deterministically. E-G1 defaults: range_pct=20%, single_day_move_pct=50%.
_quadrant_performance_note: FOLLOWUPS #12 — regime-call accountability (collector _build_quadrant_performance, describe-only; never touches reference_weights). Per Q1-Q4 basket: 30/60/90d return + excess vs SPY (web-chart `_quadrant_series` semantics — base = first close INSIDE the window slice, so a late-joining roster member, e.g. the 2026-07-10 roster-revision additions, never retroactively distorts history), plus a favored_streak/streak_excess_pp/lagging_sessions hysteresis. suspect_after_sessions is how many consecutive AS-OF-THAT-SESSION-negative sessions a FAVORED bucket must run (recomputed each session, not just read off today) before the prompt's `suspect` gate fires — i.e. a bucket the book has been concentrating into that has lagged SPY every single session it's been checked for this many sessions running. This block only raises the evidentiary bar in the analyzer's PROSE for increasing a suspect bucket further; it is describe-only, same as divergences/transition_watch's Phase-2/3 role before Phase 4 wired them in. 2026-08-21 quadrant-reachability audit (Task E, finding F7) — the legacy streak path above requires ONE UNBROKEN run of negative-streak sessions, so a regime call flipping favored on/off every 3-5 sessions (the observed 2026-05-26..08-21 pattern) could never survive to suspect_after_sessions even while genuinely losing every time it was checked; this defeated the exact guardrail meant to catch a bad regime call. `suspect` is now the OR of that legacy path and a NEW rolling path: `favored_sessions_N >= min_favored_sessions AND trailing_excess_pp_N < suspect_excess_threshold_pp`, where N = trailing_window_sessions (a plain fixed-N-session window, favored-continuity-independent). `cumulative_favored_excess_pp` is a never-reset, whole-series running total of day-over-day excess on favored sessions only. Defaults (window 20 / min favored 5 / threshold 0.0pp) are a starting proposal (decision D-5) — accept for now, tune after ~30 sessions of live data.
_equity_reconciliation_note: 2026-08-21 measurement-integrity cycle, Task B (decision gate F-2) — `equity`, `cash`, and `net_mv` (sum of position market_value) are computed on adjacent lines in the collector and were never checked against each other, even though `equity` is the single number the entire performance chart rests on. `paper_account.reconciliation` (`_build_equity_reconciliation`) flags a `mismatch` when `|equity - (cash + net_mv)| > tolerance`, where `tolerance = max(equity * tolerance_pct_of_equity / 100, tolerance_floor_usd)`. Some drift is legitimate (unsettled trades, accrued-but-unposted dividends, fractional rounding) — these starting defaults (0.25% of equity, floor $50) are a first cut; tighten once a few weeks of live deltas show the account's real noise floor. Non-fatal and non-gating: a mismatch is recorded and logged, never blocks the snapshot or a trading day.
